question: Why did the predeclared Gemini 2.5 Flash availability gate return HTTP 404?

root_cause.verbatim_provider_message: This model models/gemini-2.5-flash is no longer available to new users. Please update your code to use models/gemini-3.6-flash for the latest features and improvements. We recommend you to use the Interactions API.
root_cause.interpretation: The model exists and is generally available, but generateContent is gated to pre-existing users. This Gemini Developer API free-tier credential is not eligible.
not_caused_by: client-side LiteLLM routing or api-version defect (v1beta serves this model)
model-name typo (the exact ListModels name was used)
authentication or authorization failure (no 401/403; same key lists models successfully)

listmodels_evidence.key_lesson: ListModels presence and advertised supportedGenerationMethods do NOT imply generateContent eligibility for the calling account.

documentation_divergence.models_page_says: gemini-2.5-flash listed as Stable, 'best price-performance model for low-latency, high-volume tasks that require reasoning'
documentation_divergence.deprecations_page_says: release date 2025-06-17; no shutdown date announced; no new-user restriction stated
documentation_divergence.pricing_page_says: Free Tier input and output free of charge
documentation_divergence.api_says: 404 - no longer available to new users
documentation_divergence.conclusion: Official documentation does not disclose the new-user eligibility gate. Documentation verification alone is INSUFFICIENT as an availability gate; only a live probe establishes eligibility.

protocol_consequence.reason_not_tested: The predeclared protocol forbids automatically testing a third Gemini model after a gate failure, including the gemini-3.6-flash replacement named in the provider's own error message. A research-level model/provider decision is required.
